mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies at 62 degrees near Harriet Park. The overnight low will drop to 62 degrees, and we do have rain predicted overnight.
We have no new inbound emails to report at this time. Our police department continues to monitor city activities, including a recent, unusual trend of cars being pranked with cheese slices.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of events to choose from, including trivia at Hop Haus Brewing, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.

In a noteworthy call from September 5, Verona police officers investigated reports of multiple vehicles featuring a slice of cheese on their windshields, which they identified as a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the night for a remodel. We look forward to seeing them open again tomorrow at 10 AM, when they will feature a new flavor of the day.
